meta_description: Hampsons Heating is your local Stoke-on-Trent plumber. Emergency repairs, boiler servicing, and heating installations. Call us now for same-day help.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler? We arrive fast in Stoke and surrounding areas, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Stoke-on-Trent
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full boiler installations, we handle every heating and plumbing job with speed and care.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most issues on the first visit, day or night.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler safe and efficient. If it breaks down, we diagnose and repair most models same day without excessive delays.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted and commissioned with full certification. We help you choose the right model for your home and budget, with transparent pricing upfront.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold radiators bled and refilled, or new ones fitted throughout your home. We balance your heating system to maximise warmth and efficiency.

services.title: Pipe Work & Heating System Installation
services.desc: New heating systems designed and installed to Code of Practice standards. Whether it's a small repair or a full system overhaul, we do it right.

services.title: Heating System Upgrades & Powerflush
services.desc: Improve your boiler's lifespan and reduce energy bills with a professional powerflush. We clear sludge and corrosion from your entire heating circuit.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing locals overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: Hampsons Heating was founded 18 years ago in Stoke-on-Trent with one simple goal: to give local homeowners honest, fast, and fair-priced heating and plumbing help. We've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted local team, and we've completed over 1,000 jobs across the city and surrounding areas. Every visit is backed by our commitment to get it right the first time.
about_para_2: Our customers keep coming back because we answer the phone, turn up on time, and don't charge a call-out fee just for showing up. We specialise in emergency work — burst pipes at midnight, boilers packed in during a cold snap — but we're just as happy to service your boiler or plan a new heating system for you. Word of mouth and repeat bookings are 70% of our work, and that tells you everything.

about_stats.label: You only pay for the work

reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Homeowners Say About Hampsons Heating

reviews.text: Called them at 11pm on a Saturday night with a burst pipe. They were here by midnight and had it sorted by 1am. Really friendly lad, charged a fair price and didn't try to upsell me. Top job.
reviews.author: Marcus W.

reviews.text: Had Hampsons round for my annual boiler service. Thorough, efficient, and they spotted a small issue with the flue before it became a problem. That's the kind of attention you want. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Catherine T.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted last month. They explained everything clearly, didn't mess about, and the installation was clean. Heating's so much better now and my bills are already lower. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.
